name: Baber Arjumand
headline: Software Engineer | Frontend Lead
tagline: Software Engineer & Technical Leader — React · TypeScript · Node.js · Go

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and technical leader with over 6 years building production web and mobile products across the full stack, in roles from Frontend Lead to CTO. Shipped cross-border payment platforms, Web3 social products, and AI conversational commerce tools with fully remote teams across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf.

bullets: Founded and operate an online marketplace pairing children and adults with private Quran teachers, covering matching, scheduling, and lesson delivery.
Direct product strategy, UX, and full-stack engineering as sole technical owner, plus teacher vetting and search visibility.
Architected a B2B cross-border payment platform from concept to alpha in React and Tailwind CSS across an 8-month engagement.
Engineered Node.js, Express, and MongoDB services with Python microservices handling financial data analysis and reporting.
Integrated Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions and shipped a real-time multi-branch liquidity dashboard, plus a settlement recommendation engine.
Delivered end-to-end features for an AI conversational commerce platform in React, powering campaigns across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Messenger, and Discord.
Engineered distributed Go and PostgreSQL services on AWS to sustain high-concurrency messaging workflows.
Migrated the unified customer inbox from Redux to Jotai, and built engagement analytics dashboards with Datadog monitoring.
Directed frontend architecture for a Web3 social platform that aggregates and verifies cross-chain digital assets and NFTs.
Led a full migration from legacy Angular to React and Next.js, improving load performance, SEO, and scalability.
Engineered proprietary multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect, and led a distributed frontend team.
Led frontend delivery in Angular and React across concurrent client accounts as senior technical consultant.
Engineered backend APIs with NestJS and modelled complex data in ArangoDB to close the full-stack loop.
Translated business needs into software requirements specifications and phased development roadmaps.
Directed 4 technical functions — web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing — across a concurrent client portfolio.
Supervised global offshore teams delivering React, Angular, Node.js, and WordPress products for healthcare, food service, and non-profit clients.
Owned budgets, timelines, and QA across the full SDLC, and hired full-stack developers, SEO analysts, and content strategists.
Set technical strategy and converted business requirements into specifications and Agile sprint plans.
Directed engineering teams through the full SDLC and administered enterprise IT infrastructure and web services.

items.role: Full Stack Engineer, then Frontend Developer
bullets: Delivered full-stack applications spanning React and Angular frontends, REST API design, and database schema optimization.
Shipped Ionic progressive web apps and hybrid iOS and Android builds with in-app subscriptions through both app stores.
Integrated Stripe, Apple, and Google payments, and configured CI/CD on AWS, Heroku, and Firebase.
Architected the Angular frontend from scratch with automated CI/CD through AWS Amplify.
Engineered a Spring Boot backend on AWS EC2, integrated Stripe Connect for a vendor marketplace, and ran intern workshops.
Built an on-demand laundry marketplace in Ionic for iOS and Android, from concept to alpha release.
Engineered a serverless backend on Firebase Cloud Firestore and Cloud Functions, with internationalization for multi-region launch.
Deliver custom web solutions for small and mid-sized businesses, spanning brand sites, e-commerce, and food-delivery management systems.
Build with React and Node.js alongside WordPress, Webflow, and Squarespace, integrating payments, CRM, and marketing automation.
